decisions.reason: s0162 gives courtesy name 彥璋 (Yànzhāng). Yanehang is a clear romanization error; Yanzhang restores the correct reading without changing the rest of the accurate sentence.
The same unit 沈憲字彥璋 requires Yanzhang, not Yanehang, in the literal field. The proposed spelling corrects the typo and leaves the remaining wording intact.

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0001 shows English Yanehang came only from the bad romanization of 彥璋; the courtesy-name claim remains valid with en corrected to Yanzhang while zh, pinyin, id, subject, predicate, certainty, and evidence stay unchanged.
